content.title: Chapter 30 - ELECTIONS — Sec. 30-69. - Reimbursement to incumbent not recalled.
content.summary:
If at any recall election, the incumbent whose recall is sought is not recalled, the
               councilmember may be repaid from the state treasury if permitted by and in accordance
               with applicable state law.
(Code 1981, § 11-40; Ord. No. 3511, § 2, 2-1-1999)
